bucket_reason: med confidence; the funded decider stage (decider2) found no certificate, so what remains is a multi-stage hand proof or parking
question: The decider route found nothing (384 hlin and 178 CTL runs, all false): start the hand proof with one stage that pins the open rules, or park W4-7 and its sibling 707?

options.label: Hand proof, first stage: pin the open rules (about 2 h)
options.consequence: Exact rules for the bell hand-over E (both ways), the carry J2 past a wide 2 and the second field's size at each left-end visit, each validated from random instances; then proof.md (two bells + ternary counter with wide digits) and Rocq in later stages. Stop rule: park if the field-size law is still not exact after this stage.

options.label: Park W4-7 (and 707)
options.consequence: No further cost now. Both stay holdouts; the extracted hlin and CTL runners, the grids and the traces stay in scripts/ for reuse.

rationale: All 384 hlin runs (317, 707) and 178 CTL runs were false; the framework has no side rule for wide digits.
Mechanism mostly pinned (13 rules, 200/200 each) and not cryptid-like; 707 shows the same two fields.
Open: E, J2 and the second field's size law; the first stage tests exactly these, with a stop rule.

evidence.text: Fig 3: records from start A (ours): the second field shows as vertical streaks
hlin decider extracted and calibrated against Coq (cert start B true in 0.01 s); 384 configs on 317/707 (block size 0-12, T up to 1e6, fuel up to 1e6): 0 true
200 left-end visits to 3e7: field 1 grows by exactly 1 block each time (199/199); the second field's first segment by 0 (133 times) or 1-8 (66)
13 local rules validated 200/200 (F, K1-K6, I0-I2, J0, J1); E and J2 seen in traces only

effort_if_yes: about 2 h of agent time for the first stage (light simulation, no Coq); proof.md and Rocq are later stages
